column2: The battle data for one war. Every war has a workbook like this one, with the same sheets in the same order; a sheet with nothing for this war keeps its headings so the layout stays the same.

Sources, Source candidates and the change log of the battle data are in "Sources and notes.xlsx", in the same folder. Every source id (S01, S02 ...) is listed there once, for every war: add a new source there, with the next free id.

python3 tools/export_battles.py reads every workbook in the folder and writes each playback's battle file (playbacks/<playback>/battle.json). It also writes each sheet as a CSV file under csv/ in this folder, so GitHub can show what changed.
Written on 23 Nov 2026 from the single workbook "WarMapper battle data.xlsx", which it replaces (pipeline/split_workbook.py). Every row and every id is as it was.

One row per disputed point, in place of the Conflicts sheet: the question, the readings (A, B, C), the evidence for and against the reading the playback follows, each item with its source and page, the reading adopted, how sure it is, who decided and when, the rows it touches and what would settle it. The history column keeps everything the Conflicts row said. Status: Open (a ruling is wanted), Proposed (a reading is put forward for Morgan to accept), Settled, No ruling needed.

One row per campaign playback and battle playback inside it (BP-34). The campaign lists its battles, with a button that opens each at its date; the battle links back to the campaign at the date on its clock. Columns: link_id, campaign_playback, battle_playback (playback ids from Playbacks), label and campaign_label (optional names), opens_at (optional: where the battle opens from the campaign; its start if empty), notes. Dates come from Playbacks.

The Battle of Cowpens, 17 January 1781, added as campaign ARW-SOU, battle COWP, playback "cowpens": rows CP01 to CP137, units C-..., events CE01 to CE14, routes RC01 to RC11, hypotheses CH01 to CH15, gaps CG01 to CG08. See the change log in "Sources and notes.xlsx" and pipeline/cowpens_2026_11_23.py.

Ratings, five positions and many page numbers changed after the audit and the reading of Bearss (S107); new hypotheses CH16 and CH17. See the change log in "Sources and notes.xlsx" and pipeline/cowpens_audit_2026_11_24.py.

A reconstructed 1781 base map (the playback opens on it) and nine other maps of the ground fitted to it; sources S108 to S111; CG02 closed. See the change log in "Sources and notes.xlsx" and pipeline/cowpens_period_maps_2026_11_24.py.

Routes RC01 to RC06 follow the road the maps show between today's Green River Road and the old trace, in place of a straight line; CG06 partly closed. Written by pipeline/cowpens_tarleton_road_2026_11_24.py.

Opens on the whole ground; symbols less faint; Tarleton's column one symbol to the field (new row CP138), its units coming out of it; arrows reach 6 minutes ahead; blend 4 minutes. See pipeline/cowpens_playback_fixes_2026_11_24.py.

Four labels with show "far" (Gilbert Town, Charlotte, Winnsborough, Ninety Six), named at the edge of the map for orientation; about.9. Sources S112-S115. See pipeline/cowpens_far_towns_2026_11_24.py.

Surrendered infantry leave the map at 07:56 (CP56, CP66, CP76, CP104); Washington drawn arriving at 08:22 (CP37) so he stays behind Tarleton; camera holds wide until 06:12; the column marches at 1 minute a second. See pipeline/cowpens_review2_2026_11_24.py.

Rows that say the same as the battle's presets are taken off Playback settings; based_on names the presets; the new why column gives the reason where a battle differs. See the Playback presets sheet in Sources and notes.xlsx.
